name: Tsuzuki Takashi
source:
2nd year high school student.
Energetic and cheerful, he's a nosy troublemaker. He looks like the type to hate studying, but Takashi passionately does so in whatever piques his interest. He excels in elemental magic.

[Translation of his [URL=http://www.p-reve.com/goes/#!/chara]official website profile[/URL].]
